purpose: Reserved taxonomy for future LoRA aesthetic tuning from real case images and reference images.

design_domains.description: App, dashboard, web product, mobile screen, component, and design-system references.
Key visual, campaign poster, typography poster, event poster, and series poster references.
Competition board, presentation board, multi-panel layout, and analysis board references.
Logo, brand identity, brand boards, visual systems, and brand application references.
Interior, landscape, exhibition, spatial analysis, and environment-board references.
Product packaging, label, box, bag, bottle, and commerce touchpoint references.
Expressive type, custom lettering, layout rhythm, and text hierarchy references.
Diagram, map, data narrative, timeline, flowchart, and technical visualization references.
Landing page, editorial web, product site, documentation, and responsive web references.
Storyboard, shot board, scene style, character continuity, and video prompt references.

style_axes.control_goal: quiet surface, restrained palette, clear focal anchor, high whitespace
strong grid, reading path, modular hierarchy, print-like order
geometric alignment, sans typography, strict spacing, neutral contrast
inspectable product, clean lighting, controlled reflections, credible material
soft light, warm neutrals, delicate material, low-noise atmosphere
precise geometry, luminous accents, dark-light contrast, no random sci-fi clutter
cultural symbols translated into modern structure without literal ornament overload
clear analysis logic, plan fidelity, spatial hierarchy, board-level readability
expressive letterform, exact text, legible hierarchy, controlled distortion
label accuracy, diagram clarity, visual grouping, thin-line discipline

project_contexts.description: Market-facing brand, packaging, retail, product, service, or client-delivery design references.
project_contexts.control_goal: conversion, brand recognition, production polish, commercial clarity

project_contexts.description: University design competition, discipline research, course, and proposal boards with research logic and academic storytelling.
project_contexts.control_goal: research framing, evidence chain, methodology, visual analysis, coherent board logic

project_contexts.description: Culture China, Chinese cultural tourism, heritage communication, and regional culture works that combine research, infographics, narrative illustration, interaction, and applied displays.
project_contexts.control_goal: cultural interpretation, regional knowledge, information visualization, illustrated storytelling, non-commercial civic or academic tone

project_contexts.description: Public culture, museum, tourism, education, and city communication projects with civic or educational value.
project_contexts.control_goal: accessibility, cultural clarity, public readability, respectful visual language
